title: Lexicographic functional calculus and its application to functional calculus calculus
summary: Let $A$ be a unital $C^*$-algebra and $I$ be a symmetrically normed ideal of $A$. I introduce and study lexicographic functional calculus (LFC), a kind of multivariate functional calculus for tuples $(a_1,\ldots,a_m)$ of noncommuting self-adjoint elements of $A$ ''acting in lexicographic order,'' i.e., from left to right, with an element $b_i \in I$ ''inserted'' between the action of $a_i$ and $a_{i+1}$ for each $i=1,\ldots,m-1$. The reason for its introduction is an application to ''functional calculus calculus,'' the differential calculus of maps induced by single-variate (continuous)…
